 from openlibrary.plugins.openlibrary import lists
+from openlibrary.plugins.upstream import utils
+import web
 
 
 def test_process_seeds():
@@ -11,3 +13,50 @@ def test_process_seeds():
     assert f({"key": "/books/OL1M"}) == {"key": "/books/OL1M"}
     assert f("/subjects/love") == "subject:love"
     assert f("subject:love") == "subject:love"
+
+
+def test_list_record_post_uses_body_without_query(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'data', lambda: b'name=Body&name=Ignored&description=From+body&seeds=OL1M')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **defaults: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError('query read')))
+
+    record = lists.ListRecord.from_input()
+
+    assert record.name == 'Body'
+    assert record.description == 'From body'
+    assert record.seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL1M'}]
+    assert record.key is None
+
+
+def test_list_record_post_nested_seeds_ignore_invalid_items(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        web,
+        'data',
+        lambda: b'name=Body&seeds--0--key=%2Fbooks%2FOL1M&seeds--1--other=bad&seeds--2--key=&seeds--3--key=%2Fworks%2FOL1W',
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **defaults: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError('query read')))
+
+    record = lists.ListRecord.from_input()
+
+    assert record.seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL1M'}, {'key': '/works/OL1W'}]
+
+
+def test_list_record_post_empty_nested_seed(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'data', lambda: b'name=Body&seeds--0--key=')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **defaults: (_ for _ in ()).throw(AssertionError('query read')))
+
+    assert lists.ListRecord.from_input().seeds == []
+
+
+def test_list_record_query_defaults_when_body_empty(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'data', lambda: b'')
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', lambda **defaults: web.storage({**defaults, 'name': 'Query', 'seeds': ['/books/OL1M']}))
+
+    record = lists.ListRecord.from_input()
+
+    assert record.name == 'Query'
+    assert record.seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL1M'}]
+
+
+def test_unflatten_last_simple_assignment_wins():
+    assert utils.unflatten({'name--nested': 'value', 'name': 'last'})['name'] == 'last'
+    assert utils.unflatten({'name': 'first', 'name--nested': 'last'})['name'] == {'nested': 'last'}
